decision.explanation: Two distinct but potentially overlapping referents named 'Richard Aldworth' appear in the sources. One is born on 3 July 1750 (D1S3), and another on 12 December 1750 (D2S2/D3S3). The 3 September 1717 date (D4S1/D5S1) refers to Richard Neville Aldworth Neville, a different individual. Since the question asks for the birth date of 'Richard Aldworth,' both 3 July 1750 and 12 December 1750 are valid under distinct referents. No source resolves which name applies to the same person, so both are retained as valid candidates.
